clinical.individual_fraction: (OFF - ON) / OFF; OFF=0 yields NA only for the fraction
clinical.composition_fraction: mean component improvement / mean total improvement

m4_reference.distances: absolute difference from common HC M4 center
m4_reference.estimand: arithmetic mean of paired distance change
m4_reference.resampling: Independent resampling of 15 HC and 25 complete patient pairs, with one re-estimated shared center per draw

inference: No new P-value tests. Compare the M4 distance estimate and percentile interval; cite old BH5/BH4 unchanged.
